title: The Kozmikk Kut Reborn
description: A total revamp of the base game that tries to remain somewhat faithful. Made for use on The Kozmikk Kut SMP server
body:
The Kozmikk Kut Reborn is a successor to [The Kozmikk Kut](https://modrinth.com/modpack/the-kozmikk-kut). Improving MANY of the original features it had. This pack is designed to work well on a SMP server and comes pre-configured to allow everything to work together.

If you would like to join the 24/7 SMP server then join the discord and ask for a whitelist

# Features

### Revamped World Gen
The world & underworld has been revamped with the use of teconic. Vanilla Biomes have been enhanced with Wilder Wild. New biomes have been added in with Regions Unexplored 🌱

### Ocean Exploration
The world is broken up into continents, archipelagos and islands seperated by varied types of ocean. Oceans can now be almost as deep as bedrock in some areas. Filled with MANY new types of sealife and plants with Hybrid Aquatic and Naturalist. Explore with the Small Ships mod or personal submarine from Immersive Machinery 🌊

### Exploration/Vehicles
Explore the newly refreshed world with Carts, Aircraft, Gliders, Grappling Hooks and Waystones!

### Revamped/New Dimensions
The Nether has been completly transformed with the Better Nether mod and the End with Nullscape. Two new dimensions have also been added "The Otherside" and "The Aether"!

### New Structures
Hundreds of new strucutres have been added thanks to Dungeons and Taverns, Phillips Ruins, Wabi Sabi Structures and Yung's collection of dungeon revamps

### New Mobs
Encounter a menagerie of fascinating new creatures with AdventureZ, Friends & Foes, Naturalist and More Mob Variants 🐔!

### Farming & Cooking Revamp
With Farmer's Delight and many addons cooking is fun again. All the new plants and Overweight Farming make farming much more varied 🍔

### Ambience, Visuals and Sounds ✨
Includes a custom config of Complementary Reimagined shader pack. New particles and effects provided by Subtle Effects, Effective, Visuality, FootprintParticle, Explosive Enhancments, Immersive Weathering, Wakes and serveral animation mods used to make the game look new! Presence Footsteps, Sounds, Dynamic Surroundings and Drip Sounds fill your world with new sounds

### New Creations
Team up with friends to create amazing contraptions and structures with Create/addons, Tom's Simple Storage, Adorn, Chipped, Handcrafted and many many new items/block

### Villages Improved!
Guard villages, Better Villages, Village Names, Illager Invastion and a new village type Ribbits 🐸. DON'T steal from them though or the guards might have something to talk to you about!

### Land Management! 
Using Cadmus and the teaming system of Argonauts thru Journeymap you can protect your land how you want!

### Preset Controls, UI & Settings! 
Everything is pre-configured for you to just get going. Upon Modpack updates your settings will also be remembered! ⚙️

### Custom Mod Config, QOL & Balance Changes! 
Complete list can be found [here](https://drive.proton.me/urls/F918P1QJ08#1Hw4WwftGLVf)
